name: CraftBench
intro: CraftBench 不是独立评测集，而是 Agent World Model（AWM）论文附录表 15 中的 Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker 场景。固定官方记录进一步公开了该场景的 10 个任务、18 张表、114 条初始插入和 50 个端点；构建沿用 AWM 通用合成流程，但没有 CraftBench 专属划分、提示、评测程序或指标。
build_method: 以 100 个热门域名为种子，经 Self-Instruct 扩展、CRUD 分类、余弦阈值 0.85 的嵌入去重和类别上限得到 1,000 个场景；每场景生成 10 个 API 可解、登录后的任务，再合成 SQLite 状态、MCP 工具、验证器并做最多 5 次执行自纠错
metric: 无独立 CraftBench 指标；AWM 任务奖励为完成 1.0、部分完成 0.1、其他 0.0，工具调用格式错误时步骤奖励为 −1 并提前终止
eval_feature: SQL 状态变化验证与代码增强 LLM 判分；不是 CraftBench 专属评测
scale: CraftBench 官方记录：10 个任务、18 张表、114 条初始插入、18 个 API 组与 50 个端点；AWM 全集为 1,000 个环境、10,000 个任务
build_method_en: Seed 100 popular domains; expand with Self-Instruct; apply a CRUD classifier, embedding cosine threshold 0.85 and category caps; generate 10 API-solvable post-authentication tasks per scenario; then synthesize SQLite state, MCP tools and verifiers with up to five execution-based correction attempts
eval_feature_en: SQL state-difference verification and code-augmented LLM judging; not a CraftBench-specific evaluation
intro_en: CraftBench is not a standalone evaluation set. It is the Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker scenario sampled in Agent World Model Appendix Table 15. The pinned official record further publishes 10 tasks, 18 tables, 114 initial inserts and 50 endpoints. It follows the AWM-wide synthesis pipeline but has no CraftBench-specific split, prompt, evaluation harness or metric.
scale_en: Pinned CraftBench record: 10 tasks, 18 tables, 114 initial inserts, 18 API groups and 50 endpoints; AWM overall: 1,000 environments and 10,000 tasks
metric_en: No standalone CraftBench metric; AWM task reward is 1.0 for Completed, 0.1 for Partially Completed and 0.0 otherwise; a tool-call format violation receives step reward −1 and terminates the rollout

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Agent World Model arXiv:2602.10090v3 §3.1, §3.2, and §3.3 plus Appendix Table 15; fixed official sources are Snowflake-Labs/agent-world-model full commit 85e322f69279e3b3325b7377ec3bab788514e9cb and Snowflake/AgentWorldModel-1K revision dde80a0283fe781bdc51656bce57063dc5650213. CraftBench is the Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker record with scenario id manufacturing_execution_system_1, 10 tasks, 18 tables, 114 initial INSERT rows, 18 API groups, and 50 endpoints. The AWM-wide path is 100 domain seeds, Self-Instruct expansion, CRUD filtering, embedding cosine deduplication at 0.85, category caps, task generation, SQLite state, MCP interface, verifier, and execution-based self-correction. It has no standalone CraftBench split, prompt, evaluation harness, or metric; the shown Completed 1.0, Partially Completed 0.1, otherwise 0.0 task formula and format-error −1 early termination are explicitly AWM training rewards only.
